name: Phone, Android mid-range (OpenGL ES 3.2 / Vulkan), 30 fps
basis: OpenGL ES 3.2 includes ASTC LDR textures in its core (Khronos OpenGL ES 3.2 specification); Vulkan devices of this class report textureCompressionASTC_LDR. Texture formats are a common choice (ASTC 6x6 colour, 4x4 normal maps), not a vendor rule. Budgets are left unset: a team sets its own in its own profile.
